title: Large language models perceive cities through a culturally uneven baseline

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models with different meso-regional cultural identities to describe and rate street-view images, then measuring semantic distance to a neutral baseline, sentiment-based ingroup preference, and shifts in structured perception scores (e.g., safety, wealth, beauty).
Evaluating whether models can reproduce human gender differences in urban perception using a qscore-based pairwise street-scene comparison benchmark.
Evaluating whether models can reproduce human age differences in urban perception using a qscore-based pairwise street-scene comparison benchmark.
Evaluating whether models can reproduce human country-level differences in urban perception using a qscore-based pairwise street-scene comparison benchmark.
